verifiedSystems.potentialSkills: chance-based equipment skill enhancements or stat boosts; preservable by Sealing and inheritable
verifiedSystems.traitSystem: base traits removed from gear drops; traits unlocked with Trait Unlockstones and enhanced with Trait Enhancement Stones
verifiedSystems.traitResonance: four growth stages with four resonance slots, rollable up to 10 each

dataPolicy: Only verified values are used in calculations; missing item-specific Nix values remain unscored.
